future_solver_cost.concurrency3_governance: functional stability evidence only; not throughput optimal

future_success_criteria.ranking: near-champion ordering materially clarified OR agreement confirmed
future_success_criteria.tail: continuous/error-cluster localization OR informative negative result showing isolated/proxy failure

identity_freeze_order: This preregistration hash must precede final candidate identity generation.
marginal_value_contract: compare Primary2 versus Primary2+next2 backups on tail localization, ranking ambiguity, P/S information, redundancy, LF response diversity
normalization: min-max fit on eligible candidate universe only; no HF truth, external metadata, or sealed metadata used for score fitting
plateau_stop_rule: If after Primary2 and M9 no model passes all gates, common-HF20 lacks consistent improvement, and tail/champion failures do not converge, stop automatic development-HF loop and enter FORWARD_MODEL_PLATEAU_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

roles.RANKING-DISAMBIGUATION: reduce champion/Top-K ambiguity near current Pareto frontier
roles.TAIL-LOCALIZATION: localize whether M7A G01 residual-tail is isolated, smooth local, diameter-jump-driven, P/S-dependent, or order-redistribution cluster

selection_rule.backup_order: deterministic interleaving tail/ranking/mixed queues by frozen score and geometry_hash
selection_rule.optional_first4: Primary2 plus next two backups only; not default recommendation
selection_rule.ranking_pick: highest ranking_score excluding tail pick, then lowest physical redundancy, then descending geometry_hash
selection_rule.tail_pick: highest tail_score, then lowest physical redundancy, then descending geometry_hash
